outcome: Emergency cesarean section for fetal compromise
Admission to neonatal critical care unit
cohort: 1224 women with singleton pregnancies who attempted vaginal delivery
finding: A cerebro-umbilical ratio of ≤1 at 30-34 weeks gestation is associated with a greater risk of emergency cesarean section for fetal compromise and other adverse perinatal outcomes, particularly in low birth weight babies.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by emergency cesarean section for fetal compromise had lower cerebro-umbilical ratios (CUR) compared to other delivery groups.
